chapters.text: MESH: Ruby backend engineering, from partner package to a confirmed release.
A studio submits a private ZIP and a manifest. Validation checks exact bytes, inventory and the real scanner.
The bad package is rejected: FILE_DIGEST explains the defect. Publishing stays disabled.
A corrected package passes. The validation is bound to its digest, policy and integration configuration.
Inject a lost response through the real API. The independent HTTP partner commits the release before the reply is lost.
HTTP_TIMEOUT becomes unknown. A missing response does not authorize another publish request.
Read-only diagnosis provides a safe next action: look up the same operation ID. It does not query remote state.
The ordinary dispatcher reconciles by lookup. Confirmation must match the operation, artifact digest and sequence.
One real publish request, one remote effect. The captured workflow is a local simulator exercise, not a live external studio.
